N8N Chat UI

Maker

📌

Hey Product Hunt 👋 Ross (@ross\_jenkins) & Dani (@dani\_martin1), the owners of N8N Chat UI.  
  
The problem  
n8n is brilliant for building AI agents, but its built-in chat widget is basic. Making it look like your brand means digging into HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and your webhook URL sits in the page source for anyone to find.  
  
What we built  
A visual builder that turns any n8n workflow into a polished, on-brand chat widget. Customize it with a live preview, copy one snippet, and it's on your site. No code.  
Try the builder yourself, no signup needed: n8nchatui.com  
  
Key features

 Popup or in-page widgets, fully themed: colors, fonts, avatars, welcome messages, custom CSS [...] Streaming replies, voice input, file uploads, follow-up prompts, Markdown/HTML rendering

 RTL support for Arabic, Hebrew and Persian

 Managed widgets: hidden webhook, domain restrictions, geofencing, rate limits and real-time analytics

 MCP server: ask Claude, Cursor or VS Code to create and restyle widgets for you

 Official plugins for WordPress, Webflow, Shopify and Wix, plus an n8n community node

For developers: it's no-code, but not locked down

 Send messages programmatically with sendMessage(): start a chat from a "Ask about this product" button, a form submission, a URL parameter, or after a visitor has been idle on the checkout page

 Event callbacks (onWidgetOpen, beforeSubmit, onResponseReceived, onError…) to hook the chat into your analytics or app logic
